resumen: Lying face up, you lift the shoulders and straight legs off the floor and hold the position with the lower back pressed down. The body forms a curve, like a banana.
ejecucion: Lie on your back with your arms stretched behind your head and your legs together and straight.
Press your lower back into the floor by bracing your abs.
Lift your shoulders and legs off the floor at the same time, arms by your ears, and hold.
Keep breathing without letting your abs go the whole time.
If your lower back lifts, bend your knees or bring your arms by your sides to make it easier.
matices: We have found no study measuring the hollow hold itself; it comes from gymnastics conditioning. It is progressed with leverage: with the arms by your sides and the knees bent it is much easier than fully stretched out. As general context, a systematic review of core exercises notes that the studies measuring these exercises use hard-to-compare methods.

fuentes.titulo: Core Muscle Activity During Physical Fitness Exercises: A Systematic Review
fuentes.autor: Oliva-Lozano and Muyor, Int J Environ Res Public Health, 2020
